title: TSS, TXS, SDS Serial Extraction
author: Haley Geertsma
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b5vvq666

steps.title: Prepare and Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Weigh the brain sample and homogenize it using a dounce homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Add 3X volume of TSS buffer (140mM NaCl + 5mM Tris-HCl in H2O) and 1X protease inhibitor to the sample.
Transfer the homogenate to a clean tube.

steps.title: Extract TSS Fraction
steps.instruction: Isolate the TSS fraction through centrifugation.

steps.title: Wash TSS Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet to remove residual TSS buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the same volume of TSS buffer.

steps.title: Extract TXS Fraction
steps.instruction: Isolate the TXS fraction using Triton X-100 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the same volume of TXS buffer (TSS buffer + 0.5% Triton X-100).

steps.title: Wash TXS Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet to remove residual TXS buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the same volume of TSS buffer.

steps.title: Extract SDS Fraction
steps.instruction: Isolate the SDS fraction using sodium dodecyl sulfate buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the same volume of SDS buffer (TSS buffer + 1% sodium dodecyl sulfate).
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 21130g for 30 minutes at room temperature.
